message.content:
We use the standard integral:

∫ exp(x)*cos(x) dx = (1/2)*exp(x)*(sin(x) + cos(x)) + C

So,

∫ -3*exp(x)*cos(x) dx = -3 * ∫ exp(x)*cos(x) dx  
= -3 * (1/2)*exp(x)*(sin(x) + cos(x)) + C  
= (-3/2)*exp(x)*(sin(x) + cos(x)) + C

<answer>(-3/2)*exp(x)*(sin(x) + cos(x)) + C</answer>
